rules.summary: Explicit nets and default_nettype boundary
Sized arithmetic constants
Explicit signedness and width at mixed expressions
No unintended latch in combinational paths
Nonblocking assignment for sequential state
One driver per net or state
Complete Module Contract v1 on each module
Payload, valid, ready and sideband stage alignment
Approved cross-clock structure
Review preservation and debug attributes

rules.evidence: source manifest and multi-file elaboration report
rules.summary: Explicit design units, dependencies and compile configuration
Generated RTL provenance and immutable output
Functional signal names and consistent suffixes

rules.evidence: numeric contract, range proof or boundary test
rules.summary: Fixed-point format, overflow and narrowing semantics
No combinational loops or simulation-synthesis mismatch

rules.evidence: FSM contract, illegal-state assertion and recovery review
rules.summary: Evidence-based FSM encoding and illegal-state behavior

rules.evidence: reset topology, RDC report and owner signoff
rules.summary: Reset scope, release and reset-domain crossing

rules.evidence: clock topology, constraints and implementation review
rules.summary: Generated and gated clocks use approved structures

rules.evidence: CDC report, synchronizer review and timing exception proof
rules.summary: CDC protocol and constraints match actual circuit
Stable payload and sideband under backpressure

rules.evidence: memory contract, inference report and boundary tests
rules.summary: Memory semantics, inference target and initialization

rules.evidence: storage boundary or documented inline rationale with inference and latency review
rules.summary: Separate nontrivial storage implementation from access control; allow small local arrays inline

rules.evidence: content-addressed four-state shadow inventory plus review
rules.summary: No unsafe X/Z or unsupported design constructs
Module invariants have observable verification
Readable complexity and owned TODOs

rules.evidence: wrapper, device report and target constraint
rules.summary: FPGA primitives and initialization are target-verified

rules.evidence: PDK, memory, ICG, DFT and power owner contracts
rules.summary: ASIC-specific implementation assumptions are signed off
